# PayU Payment Gateway Integration on Swipe: Step-by-step guide


> As businesses increasingly move towards digital operations, offering convenient online payment options has become essential. Integrating PayU with Swipe allows businesses to connect their payment gateway with their billing workflow, making online payment collection more convenient. This guide explains how the integration works, its key benefits, the requirements before you begin, and the steps to connect PayU with Swipe.


## What Is a PayU Payment Gateway?


PayU is an online payment gateway that enables businesses to accept digital payments from customers through supported payment methods. It facilitates the payment process between the customer, the business, and the relevant payment networks.


For businesses, a payment gateway can simplify online collections and reduce reliance on manual bank transfers. When connected to Swipe, PayU becomes part of the billing workflow, helping businesses manage their online payment process alongside their other billing activities. The payment methods available depend on the merchant account and the services enabled by PayU.


## Why Connect PayU with Swipe?


Swipe helps businesses manage billing, invoices, inventory, expenses, and GST-related activities. Connecting PayU with Swipe can bring online payment collection closer to this existing workflow, reducing the need to manage billing and payment activities through entirely separate processes.


Before activating the integration, review PayU's transaction charges, settlement terms, supported payment methods, and merchant account requirements. These factors will help you determine whether the integration meets your business's payment collection needs.


## Benefits of Integrating PayU with Swipe


### 1. Simplified Online Payment Collection


Integrating PayU with Swipe can make online payment collection more convenient by connecting payment activities with your billing workflow.


### 2. Convenient Customer Payments


Customers can use the payment methods supported by the merchant's PayU account, providing an alternative to manual bank transfers.


### 3. Reduced Manual Administration


A connected billing and payment workflow can reduce repetitive administrative tasks, depending on the features supported by the integration.


### 4. Support for Digital Business Operations


Businesses moving towards digital billing can incorporate online payment collection into their existing processes.


### 5. More Organised Payment Tracking


A connected workflow may make payment-related information easier to manage. Businesses should still reconcile transaction records with bank statements and accounting records. Available tracking and reconciliation features depend on Swipe's integration capabilities.


## Who Can Benefit from PayU Integration with Swipe?


PayU integration with Swipe may suit businesses that want to include online payment collection in their billing processes.


Business type Potential benefit


Retail businesses Offer digital payment options for eligible sales


Service providers Make it easier for customers to pay service invoices


Small and medium-sized enterprises Organise billing and online collection workflows


Online sellers Support digital payment collection for customer orders


Freelancers and independent professionals Simplify the process of collecting payments for services


Suitability depends on the business's payment requirements, PayU's merchant onboarding and approval process, and the payment methods enabled for the account.


### What You Need Before You Start


Before starting the PayU integration with Swipe, keep the following information ready:


- A business email address and mobile number
- Your business website URL, if required during onboarding
- The business and KYC documents requested by PayU
- Details of your business and its payment collection requirements
- An understanding of PayU's transaction charges and settlement terms


The exact documentation and verification requirements may vary depending on your business type and PayU's onboarding policies. Check the current requirements before beginning registration.


## How to Integrate PayU with Swipe: Step-by-Step Guide


Follow these steps to connect PayU with your Swipe account.


### Step 1: Open Settings in Swipe


Log in to your Swipe account and navigate to the Settings section.


### Step 2: Open Payment Gateway Settings


Locate the Payment Gateway option and click Connect PayU to begin the integration process.


### Step 3: Register Your PayU Account


You will be redirected to the PayU sign-up page. Enter your business email address and mobile number, then create a password.


### Step 4: Enter Your Business Website Details


When prompted, select Yes for the option to collect payments on your website. Enter your business website URL in the designated field.


### Step 5: Enable PayU on Swipe


Click Enable PayU on Swipe to proceed. Verify your mobile number using the one-time password (OTP) sent to your registered mobile number.


### Step 6: Authorise Account Access


After completing mobile verification, click Allow Access to This Account to authorise the connection. Continue with the onboarding process.


### Step 7: Complete Business KYC


Submit the required business Know Your Customer (KYC) documents to complete the verification process. Follow any additional instructions displayed during onboarding.


### Step 8: Confirm Successful Integration


Once the required steps are completed, return to Swipe. You should receive a notification confirming that the integration was successful.


Your PayU integration is then complete. Any remaining verification or activation requirements from PayU still apply.


## What if your PayU integration is not completed?


If the integration is unsuccessful, check whether your mobile number has been verified, account access has been authorised, and the required KYC documents have been submitted. If PayU is still reviewing your account, you may need to wait for its verification process to finish.


If the integration remains unsuccessful, follow the troubleshooting instructions provided by Swipe or contact the relevant support team. Confirm that any additional activation requirements have been completed before attempting to collect payments.


## Final Thoughts


Integrating PayU with Swipe can help businesses bring online payment collection into their billing workflow. Before getting started, review the setup requirements, complete the necessary account verification, and confirm that the integration is active.


Ready to begin? Visit[Swipe](https://www.getswipe.in/) to explore its billing and payment features. You can also watch the[PayU integration tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wvATqaPYcps) on YouTube for a visual walkthrough.


## FAQs


### 1. What is PayU payment gateway integration with Swipe?


PayU payment gateway integration with Swipe connects your PayU account with Swipe's billing workflow, allowing you to incorporate online payment collection into your business processes.


### 2. How can I integrate PayU with Swipe?


Open Settings in Swipe, navigate to Payment Gateway, and select Connect PayU. Follow the registration or account authorisation steps, verify your mobile number, and complete the required business KYC process. Return to Swipe to confirm the integration status.


### 3. What are the benefits of integrating PayU with Swipe?


The integration can simplify online payment collection, support convenient customer payments, and help organise payment activities alongside billing. The available features depend on the integration's supported functionality.


### 4. Do I need a PayU account to connect it with Swipe?


You need a PayU merchant account to use the payment gateway. If you do not have one, follow the registration process presented when you select Connect PayU in Swipe.


### 5. Is business KYC required for PayU integration?


PayU requires the applicable merchant verification documents. The exact requirements and activation status depend on PayU's onboarding policies and approval process.


### 6. What should I do if my PayU integration with Swipe is unsuccessful?


Check your mobile verification, account authorisation, and KYC status. If the issue persists, contact Swipe or PayU support for assistance.


### 7. Where can I check PayU transaction charges and settlement timelines?


Refer to PayU's current official pricing, merchant terms, and settlement documentation. Charges and settlement timelines may vary according to the applicable agreement and payment service.
